name: SGA 调优 — SGA 组件大小配置与调优
description: SGA 综合调优规则。覆盖 SGA 总体大小规划、各组件配比、ASMM vs AMM 选择、ORA-04031 排查。

root_causes.name: Shared Pool 碎片化或不足
Java/Streams Pool 过大
root_causes.desc: ASMM 过度分配给低优先级组件。

step1_overview.sql: SELECT component, current_size/1024/1024 current_mb, min_size/1024/1024 min_mb FROM v$sga_dynamic_components ORDER BY current_size DESC

step2_params.sql: SELECT name, value, isdefault FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sga_target','sga_max_size','memory_target','db_cache_size','shared_pool_size','large_pool_size','pga_aggregate_target')

step3_resize_ops.sql: SELECT component, oper_type, initial_size/1024/1024 init_mb, final_size/1024/1024 final_mb, start_time FROM v$sga_resize_ops WHERE start_time > SYSDATE - 1 ORDER BY start_time DESC

step4_shared_pool.sql: SELECT pool, name, ROUND(bytes/1024/1024,1) mb FROM v$sgastat WHERE pool = 'shared pool' ORDER BY bytes DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
